newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares drift to end on mixed note.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares drift to end on mixed note.

text.p: Singapore shares drifted listless and ended mixed on Friday after some cautious buying of stocks that had been in the news and selected blue chips.
"News-related stocks, like Wing Tai, hogged much of the action. There was moderate buying of blue chips but on very light volume," said one dealer.
"With the third quarter coming to an end, investors are adjusting their portfolios," said another dealer.
The key Straits Times Industrials Index slipped 1.43 points to 2,171.05. Market volume was just 84.07 million shares.
The broad market was mixed with 157 losers and 152 gainers.

Property company Wing Tai Holdings was up on news of good earnings and of its unit's 50 percent share in the purchase of a Singapore hotel totalling Singapore $380 million. The share rose Singapore $0.12 (US$0.09) to S$3.40 with 4.51 million shares traded.
United Pulp & Paper, an Indonesian-linked speculative stock, was the most active with 4.95 million shares traded. It was up S$0.05 to S$1.70.
